findings.title: Excluded source content can survive both excerpt filters
findings.evidence: Both actual processors retained all six synthetic mocked postal-contact, birthdate, and named-recipient probes. An actual native excerpt matched postal-address and mail/submission context. Its quote SHA256 was 93f6e7814348d7a23eab6cc8b1975e76400a5837010bbff866c4838a6d4cb203. No suspect text printed. Public filter relies on provider suspectedApplicantData and narrow terms; native whole-text detection and line regex miss ordinary contact/DOB/recipient wording.
findings.impact: Violates selected source-data exclusions before factual acceptance; held status does not make excluded text safe to retain.
findings.requiredRemediation: Author must enforce independent fail-closed safe-clause inspection and broader exclusions before any forwarding/persistence. Provider redaction/flags or regex alone do not certify arbitrary prose. Where safety is unclear persist hashes/counts/held reasons only. Audit all newly saved excerpts locally without reproducing excluded text; retain hashes and incident provenance.
findings.status: Partially contained: acquisition stopped; independently verified all ten initial uncommitted exactQuote values are absent now and privacy-remediation.json exists. Processor correction and recheck remain required.

findings.title: No recorded independent saved-source identity and public-blank preflight before content acquisition
findings.evidence: Triage classifies material gaps and locator type, without a per-target saved official-program/public/blank evidence gate. Public content relies on provider programIdentityClear; native content follows a single nongeneric title-token overlap. These are not independent official/public/blank provenance. Existing target references establish exact historical locator affinity, not themselves official/public/safe authority. Parent confirms saved-source preflight will be strengthened before resumption.
findings.impact: Exact frozen locator and held facts do not by themselves satisfy selected prospective source-read/content-use safeguards. No assertion is made that every queried source was unsafe.
findings.requiredRemediation: Record exact-target independently inspected applicable saved-source/identity evidence and public/blank safety preflight before further reads. Bind path/hash/pointer and program/document identity; preserve connected-access/public-origin distinction. Hold targets lacking sufficient preflight and never promote a provider flag or token overlap into conclusive scope.

findings.title: Native processor caps selected text rather than the full returned artifact envelope
findings.evidence: Full metadata/content envelopes are hashed without serialized-byte length checks. Only provider-declared file size and selected text length are bounded. A response containing additional large fields can exceed16MiB while the selected text passes.
findings.impact: The selected maximum returned artifact bound is not enforced for native results.
findings.requiredRemediation: Measure full UTF-8 serialized metadata and content envelope bytes immediately on return; hold over-limit results before dependent processing and persist only safe hashes/counts/hold reason. Maintain selected-text cap as an additional limit.
findings.status: Open; author reports planned full-envelope cap.
